enonce_intro_markdown: The floor of a rectangular room measures 600 cm long by 450 cm wide. It is to be covered with squared tiles of dimension 15 cm by 15 cm

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) Find the number of tiles used to cover the floor.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Tiles along the length: $600\div15=40$.

Tiles along the width: $450\div15=30$.

Number of tiles $=40\times30=1200$.

(Check by areas: $\dfrac{600\times450}{15\times15}=\dfrac{270\,000}{225}=1200$.)

**Answer: 1200 tiles.**
